description: This image is a false-colour infrared satellite image depicting a rural agricultural landscape. Dominant features are agricultural fields, shown in varying shades of red, white, and light grey. Bright red areas indicate healthy, vigorous vegetation, likely representing actively growing crops, vineyards, or fruit tree plantations. Lighter grey or white areas may correspond to bare soil, harvested fields, or less vegetated land. A small, dense settlement, characterised by a cluster of light grey structures, is centrally located. A winding, light grey feature, consistent with a riverbed, dry wadi, or a significant irrigation channel, is visible, particularly in the upper right and lower left quadrants. Numerous narrow linear features, likely field boundaries, roads, or tracks, crisscross the cultivated areas. The imagery highlights land cover and land use patterns, emphasizing vegetated areas through the false-colour representation.
